stem: Overlook Mutual wants an encrypted backup path for its production Direct Connect link so hybrid traffic keeps flowing during a Direct Connect maintenance window, usable within days rather than the weeks a new cross-connect takes.

choices.text: Configure a Site-to-Site VPN connection as a backup path alongside the existing Direct Connect connection
Order a second dedicated Direct Connect connection at a different location
Route hybrid traffic over the public internet without encryption during maintenance windows
Increase the existing Direct Connect connection's bandwidth with a link aggregation group

rationale: A Site-to-Site VPN can be stood up in days and provides an encrypted path independent of the Direct Connect connection during its maintenance window. A second dedicated Direct Connect connection is a sound long-term pattern but its cross-connect provisioning takes weeks. Routing unencrypted traffic over the internet fails the encryption requirement. A link aggregation group bundles connections on the same device, so it gives no separate path if that connection needs maintenance.
